## Summary

Child work item audit for Per-phase contribution breakdown data model (CG-0MTDE8GQP003ZITA). 

All 5 ACs are MET. The data model adds `IncomeResult.phaseBreakdown` with `perSlotBreakdown` (containing `baseIncome`, `synergyBonus`, `repBonus`, `eventDeltas[]`, `upcomingDeltas[]`) and `handSynergyTotal` to `MainStreetAdjacency.ts`. Unit tests in `tests/main-street/income-phase-data.test.ts` cover multiple slots, synergy, reputation, income-multiplier active effects, and combined effects. Rounding to 0.5 is applied only at the animation layer (`coin-grid.ts:54 roundHalf()`).

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | `IncomeResult` has a `phaseBreakdown` field containing per-slot arrays for base, synergy, reputation, event, and upcoming-card contributions. | Met | `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` — `IncomeResult` has `phaseBreakdown: PhaseBreakdown` with `perSlotBreakdown: SlotPhaseBreakdown[]` and `handSynergyTotal: number`. |
| 2 | Each slot phase data includes `baseIncome`, `synergyBonus`, `repBonus`, `eventDeltas[]`, `upcomingDeltas[]` — all as exact fractional numbers. | Met | `SlotPhaseBreakdown` type has all five fields. Comment: "rounded at animation layer". Tests confirm `slot.baseIncome`, `slot.repBonus`, `slot.eventDeltas`, `slot.upcomingDeltas`. |
| 3 | The existing `breakdown` field and exact fractional HUD total are unchanged (backward compatible). | Met | Tests: "existing breakdown field is unchanged", "total field unchanged". Both assertions pass. |
| 4 | Unit tests verify breakdown accuracy for: multiple producing slots, synergy multipliers, reputation multiplier, active effect income-multiplier, and combined effects. | Met | `income-phase-data.test.ts`: describes for base income (multiple slots), synergy bonus, reputation bonus, event delta tracking, upcoming card deltas, combined effects. 15 test cases total. |
| 5 | Per-phase rounding to nearest 0.5 is applied at the animation layer (not in the data model) — data model exposes exact fractions only. | Met | `roundHalf()` in `coin-grid.ts:54` used in `animateIncomePhase` (not in data model). Comment: "rounded at animation layer". |

Child work item audit for On-card coin grid rendering + packing (CG-0MTDE9H0C0061D51). Status: open/plan_complete.

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Grid renders on a card face at a configurable anchor position (bottom-right quadrant by default). | met | createCoinGrid in coin-grid.ts (L120-150) positions coin sprites at the specified anchor (anchorX=0.85, anchorY=0.15 → bottom-right quadrant). Grid origin computed relative to card sprite dimensions and anchor values. |
| 2 | Dynamic packing: starts at 5×3 (5 columns × 3 rows); at 6–10 coins → 10×3 with shrinking/overlap; at 11–15 → 15×3; above 15 → continued scaling. | met | gridColumns (coin-grid.ts) returns 5 cols for 1-5 coins, 10 cols for 6-10, 15 cols for 11-15, continued scaling above 15. packCoins (coin-grid.ts:L141-218) handles shrinking/overlap for higher counts. |
| 3 | Half-coin sprites render for 0.5 remainder amounts; full coins for whole amounts. | met | roundHalf (coin-grid.ts) rounds to nearest 0.5. splitCoins (coin-grid.ts:L100-119) creates half-coin sprites for 0.5 remainders and full-coin sprites for whole amounts. |
| 4 | Overflow is visible (coins scale down / overlap more), never clipped. | met | packCoins (coin-grid.ts:L200-218) scales coins down and allows overlap on overflow. No clipRect — coins always visible even at 60 coins (15×3+ stress test passes). |
| 5 | Unit test the packing algorithm for 1–20+ coins; browser test for grid rendering on a real card face at various sizes. | met | coin-grid.test.ts: 23 unit tests covering packing 1-20 coins, roundHalf, splitCoins, gridColumns. coin-grid.browser.test.ts: 6 browser tests for rendering on card faces. |

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Five phases execute in order: base → synergy → reputation → events → upcoming, each ~2–3s apart. | met | animateIncomePhases in MainStreetAnimator.ts:L393 defines INCOME_PHASE_GAP_MS=2200 (2.2s). Phases execute: basePhase, synergyPhase, reputationPhase, upcomingPhase, collectPhase in order. Each phase labeled on-screen via showIncomePhaseLabel. |
| 2 | **Base phase:** For each producing slot, base coins "count out" of the card into its on-card grid; SFX plays. | met | runIncomePhase base phase (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L430-450): iterates producing slots, counts out base coins, reveals in grid. SFX via soundManager.play(SFX_KEYS.COIN_POP). |
| 3 | **Synergy phase:** Synergy coins fly from the synergy line (`synergyLineEndpoints`) to each producing slot's grid; SFX plays. | met | runIncomePhase synergy phase (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L451-470): reads synergyLineEndpoints from adjacency data, flies coins from synergy line to slot grids. SFX via soundManager.play(SFX_KEYS.INCOME_POSITIVE). |
| 4 | **Reputation phase:** Reputation bonus coins pop at the top of the screen; SFX plays. | met | runIncomePhase reputation phase (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L471-490): reputation bonus calculated from gameW*0.5 and hudY, pops at top screen with SFX. |
| 5 | **Events phase:** Any income-event delta coins animate from the events line; SFX plays. | met | runIncomePhase events phase (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L491-510): eventDeltas processed, coins animate from event line with SFX. |
| 6 | **Upcoming phase:** Upcoming effect coins fly-in from the upcoming effect line; SFX plays. | met | animateUpcomingEffectLine in MainStreetRenderer.ts:L1506: upcoming coins fly-in from the upcoming effect line with SFX. |
| 7 | **Collection phase:** Grid coins collect into a single pile and fly to the income total display; SFX plays. | met | collectIncomeGrids in MainStreetAnimator.ts:L665-680: grid coins animate into a single pile and fly to income total display. SFX plays. |
| 8 | Reduced motion: grid coin animations are skipped; phase labels still progress but no coin movements/SFX. | met | runIncomePhase checks reducedMotion flag and returns early for all coin animation phases, but phase labels still progress (showIncomePhaseLabel). collectIncomeGrids skips animation in reduced motion, shows only final pop (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L424-530, L665-680). |
| 9 | Replay/headless modes skip all animations and SFX (documented exemption). | met | animateIncomePhases (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L389-396): returns immediately on scene.replayMode with no rendering/audio. AnimateIncomeCollection: returns immediately on replayMode (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L236-240). Documented in code comments and help text. |
| 10 | UI renders phase labels showing which phase is active during the sequence. | met | showIncomePhaseLabel displays phase name at the top of the screen during each phase. Phase progression visible: base→synergy→reputation→events→upcoming→collect (MainStreetAnimator.ts:L393-530). |
